title: Co-founder
product_lines: My cofounder and I started by open-sourcing alternatives to Cluely, Wispr Flow and Perplexity. Our videos reached 25M+ views, but people still struggled to install, maintain and customize the software.

Publik makes those apps accessible through our product Iris, which handles setup, fixes bugs and adds features around each user's needs. We're building a marketplace where software adapts to people, rather than people adapting to fixed subscriptions.
traction_lines: We've crossed 10K users and have 2,400 Discord members.
